chapter_title_en: Stirring the Seas Beyond | External Incarnation
chapter_seo_title: Han Li Builds a Secret Cave and Plans the External Incarnation Technique
chapter_meta_description: Han Li lands on an unknown island in the Star Seas. He digs a secret cave, buries the Heaven Vial, and coldly plans the dangerous External Incarnation technique to gain a Core Formation puppet guardian.
og_title: Chapter 378: Han Li’s New Island Fortress & The External Incarnation Gambit
og_description: After teleporting to the Star Seas, Han Li methodically builds a hidden cave system, sets up triple formations, and plans the ultimate puppet strategy.
twitter_title: A Mortal Stream breather: Han Li digs a secret base and plans a Core Formation puppet.
twitter_description: Han Li reaches a new island in the Star Seas. He digs a tunnel between two peaks, buries the Heaven Vial, and coldly calculates the External Incarnation technique.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary Daoist technique that allows a cultivator to create an independent second body; in the Mortal Stream, the crude version is just a powerful puppet that can cultivate on its own, not a true split-self.
The ability to split one’s consciousness to manipulate multiple artifacts or puppets simultaneously; requires a robust divine sense cultivated through arts like the Great Derivative Art.
A dark-aligned alternative to the Golden Core formed through forbidden methods; inferior in purity but still grants significant power.
A key cultivation technique for Han Li’s path toward Core Formation; locked translation for this specific method.
A legendary illusion-and-concealment array; even a fraction of its power is a valuable defensive asset.
A special pill that can force an incarnation to form a Demonic Core; a rare opportunity for Han Li.
